name: ccwrite
description: Japanese writing for Claude Code: writing norms, a router that adapts text to the channel and recipient, a batch copy-editor agent that keeps a draft's meaning, and warn-only checks for Markdown that renders differently from its source (emphasis next to Japanese punctuation, missing line-break spaces) and for runs of the same sentence ending.

templates_dir.title: Template directory
templates_dir.description: Where japanese-writing-router saves message templates. Empty uses the plugin data directory, which is deleted when the plugin is uninstalled; choose a directory in a private repository to keep them.
